bio.text: Jason Bunting, a Republican, represents the 106th District in the Illinois House of Representatives, a seat he has held since February 2023.

According to the General Assembly biography, he previously served as Highway Commissioner of Broughton Township and as a Livingston County Board member, and was president of the Livingston County Farm Bureau until 2023.
The biography says he has an associate degree from Joliet Junior College, graduated from Dwight Township High School, and lives in Emington with his wife and three children.
